hypothesis: Proper categorical conditional-density tree training plus median-of-ensemble decoding may reduce raw MAE when the conditional target distribution is asymmetric or multimodal.
fit_only_operations: Quantile target cells with empty-cell removal
novelty: Unlike the historical Spearman ordinal sum, squared-loss forest leaf quantiles, neural logistic mixtures and pair-difference learners, trees optimize categorical conditional probabilities for five raw-MAE endpoints and decode their ensemble CDF.
acceptance: Unmodified v148 runner: best minimum fold0/1 relative MAE reduction >0.012, frozen before confirmation; all four point gains positive; average gain >0.012; both fold2 and valid scaffold-paired bootstrap 90% lower bounds >0. No fallback after confirmation rejection.
